description.text: Copies stamped with the Pokémon Card Gym logo, given at Pokémon Card Gyms, the game and hobby shops across Japan that host official play. Most here are Mega Evolution promos of 2026: Shaymin, Mega Delphox ex, Seel, Spritzee, Grisham and Dawn in Pokémon Card Gym Promo Card Pack 4, handed out in one-card and two-card packs from 1 May 2026, and Wimpod, Mega Tatsugiri ex, Tynamo, Patrat, Special Red Card, Lida and Boss's Orders in Pack 5 from 1 August 2026. Pikachu 133/M-P, with the World Championships logo, was a participation prize at Pokémon Card Gym events from 20 June 2026, and Eevee 134/M-P the participation prize of the Deck As Is Battle events from 2 September 2026. The Pokémon Card Gym Entry Campaign, from 1 September 2026 to 28 February 2027, gave Lillie's Determination 145/M-P for two digital stamps and Mega Audino ex 146/M-P for four. Pack 6, from 1 November 2026, holds Golett, Hariyama, Gastly, Mega Heatran ex, Energy Recycler, Lebanne and Gwynn. Earlier, in the Scarlet & Violet era, Eevee 031/SV-P was the participation prize of the first Deck As Is Battle ~Get Eevee~ events from 20 January 2023 (and Eevee 198/SV-P of later ones); Pokémon Card Gym Promo Card Pack 5 from 26 January 2024 held 121/SV-P to 127/SV-P, Pack 6 from 26 April 2024 155/SV-P to 161/SV-P, Pack 7 from 19 July 2024 cards including Professor's Research 168/SV-P and 169/SV-P, and Pack 8 from 18 October 2024 184/SV-P to 190/SV-P; and the Pokémon Card Gym First Entry Campaigns gave Hawlucha 034/SV-P, Buddy-Buddy Poffin 150/SV-P and 237/SV-P, Miraidon 151/SV-P, Koraidon 152/SV-P, Noctowl 173/SV-P and Bloodmoon Ursaluna ex 258/SV-P. In the Sun & Moon era, Pikachu 214/SM-P was one of seven cards in the packs given at Pokémon Card Gym events in March, April and May 2018, and a mirror holofoil Cynthia 266/SM-P the winner's prize of the New Battle events in the September and October 2018 formats. In the Sword & Shield era, Pokémon Card Gym Promo Card Pack 1, given at Pokémon Card Gym venues from 6 December 2019 to 28 February 2020, held a non-holofoil Pikachu 024/S-P with the Pokémon Card Gym logo, and a mirror holofoil Bede 027/S-P was the winner's prize of New Battle events from 6 December 2019.
